commission.description: One rate per product category, applied to every order unless a negotiated rate exists

cashLimit.title: Cash on delivery
cashLimit.description: Maximum order total payable in cash on delivery. The courier advances the goods at the shop on pickup and collects the total from the customer; this cap bounds their exposure. Set 0 to disable cash.
cashLimit.amountHint: Integer between 0 and 10,000,000 FCFA. Applies to upcoming orders only.
cashLimit.error: Could not save the cap. Try again.

debtLimit.title: Courier maximum debt
debtLimit.description: On a cash order, eBio's commission is debited from the courier's wallet, which may go negative. Past this debt the courier receives no offers and cannot accept runs until they top up. Set 0 for no limit.
debtLimit.amountHint: Integer between 0 and 10,000,000 FCFA. Applied immediately.
debtLimit.error: Could not save the maximum debt. Try again.

supplierDebtLimit.title: Shop maximum debt
supplierDebtLimit.description: On a cash order (delivery or on-site pickup), eBio's commission is debited from the shop's wallet, which may go negative. Past this debt the shop no longer receives cash orders until it tops up its wallet; online and wallet payments stay open and pay the debt down. Set 0 for no limit.
supplierDebtLimit.amountHint: Integer between 0 and 10,000,000 FCFA. Applied immediately.
supplierDebtLimit.error: Could not save the shop maximum debt. Try again.

deliveryPricing.title: Delivery pricing
deliveryPricing.description: One rule for every shop: the fee shown to the buyer is computed by eBio from the distance between the shop and the delivery address. Applies to upcoming orders only.

mode.label: Pricing mode
mode.flatHint: The same amount whatever the distance.
mode.distanceHint: A base amount plus a per-kilometre rate, bounded and rounded.
mode.zonesHint: Distance rings, each with its own amount.

flat.feeHint: Integer ≥ 0. Charged on every delivery, whatever the distance.

distance.baseFeeHint: Pickup charge, independent of the distance.
distance.roundToHint: The total is rounded up to the next multiple. E.g. 100 → 1,240 becomes 1,300.
distance.minMaxError: The minimum must be lower than or equal to the maximum.

zones.label: Distance rings
zones.hint: 1 to {{max}} rings. They are sorted by distance on save; beyond the last ring, delivery is refused.

deliveryPricing.freeFromHint: Items subtotal, fee excluded. Empty means never free.
deliveryPricing.maxDistanceKmHint: Between 0.5 and 500 km. Beyond it, the order is refused.
deliveryPricing.error: Could not save the pricing. Check the values and try again.

grouping.title: Delivery grouping
grouping.description: When a cart spans several shops, one courier collects from each then delivers once, and the buyer pays a single fee. That fee is borne by eBio as soon as the run stretches: these two thresholds bound the exposure.
grouping.maxShopsHint: Between 1 and 5. Beyond that, the cart produces several runs, each with its own fee.
grouping.maxPickupSpreadKmHint: Two shops further apart than this are not grouped. Cannot exceed the maximum distance.
grouping.spreadOverMaxDistance: The gap between shops cannot exceed the maximum delivery distance

bannerOffers.title: Banner offers

bannerOffers.duplicateDays: Two offers cannot share the same duration.
bannerOffers.paidSlotsHint: Maximum number of sponsored banners visible at once in the carousel (0 to {{max}}). 0 pauses diffusion without cancelling requests.
bannerOffers.error: Could not save the offers. Check the values and try again.

deliveryCommission.title: eBio commission on delivery fees
deliveryCommission.description: Share eBio takes on the delivery fee of every run; the rest goes to the courier. On cash-paid orders this share is debited from the courier wallet.
deliveryCommission.rateHint: Between 0 and 50 %. Applies to upcoming deliveries only.
deliveryCommission.error: Could not save the rate. Try again.

assistant.title: {{name}}, the shopping assistant
assistant.description: {{name}} lets a buyer do their shopping by talking. Every exchange calls a paid model: close her if spending must be contained, or if she is answering badly.
assistant.stateOpen: Open: the button appears in the app and conversations are possible.
assistant.stateClosed: Closed: the button disappears from the app and every conversation is refused.
assistant.saved: Saved. The change applies within the minute.
assistant.nameHint: This name goes into her own instructions: she gives it when asked. Conversations already open keep the old one.
assistant.nameInvalid: Letters, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens only, 2 to 30 characters.
assistant.avatarHint: Shown at the top of the conversation screen and while she speaks.
assistant.avatarDefault: No portrait chosen: the one shipped with the app is used.
assistant.speedHint: Tune it by ear. ×1 was her original pace, judged too slow. Past ×1.25 she starts clipping the ends of sentences.

productReview.title: Product reviews
productReview.description: When to ask the buyer what they thought of what they received. Asking at delivery makes no sense: nobody has opened the bag yet.
productReview.delayHint: From the delivery for the first ask, then from the previous one for each reminder.
productReview.remindersHint: Reminders included. Beyond that, not answering is an answer.

escrowRelease.title: Sales payout
escrowRelease.description: When a shop receives the money of an order paid online in its wallet. Until then it stays with eBio, giving time for a complaint to come in.
escrowRelease.afterConfirmationHint: Delay after delivery once both the buyer and the shop have confirmed it. 0 = right away.
escrowRelease.maximumHint: Automatic payout after delivery, even when a confirmation is missing. 0 = on delivery. A shop can have its own delay, on its page.
escrowRelease.invalid: The delay after confirmation cannot exceed the maximum delay.

homeSections.title: Home sections
homeSections.description: What the buyer sees on opening the app: the product rails, their titles, their order and what they hold. They used to live in the code, renaming one meant shipping a new app version.

announcements.title: Announcements on opening
announcements.description: The message shown when a buyer opens the app. A shop can request one, paid from its wallet like a banner; eBio can publish its own.

referral.title: Referrals
referral.description: What a buyer-to-buyer referral pays. Both amounts are credited to the wallets on the referee's first delivered order, neither signing up nor paying triggers anything.
referral.minOrderHint: Below this amount the order pays nothing: the next one will.
referral.activeHint: Pauses the programme without erasing existing links or codes.
referral.error: Could not save the rewards. Check the values and try again.

offerTimeout.title: Time to accept a run
offerTimeout.description: A run is first offered to a single courier, the best placed. Without an answer within this delay it moves to the next; after three couriers it is offered to all. A longer delay lets the courier stop to read the offer, but delays the pickup.
offerTimeout.hint: Between 20 and 600 seconds. Applies to the next offers.
offerTimeout.error: The delay could not be saved. Try again.

newProducts.title: New products
newProducts.description: What happens when a shop adds a product: checked by eBio before buyers see it or not, and who is told by e-mail.
newProducts.validationLabel: Review new products before they go live
newProducts.validationOn: On: a new product stays hidden from buyers until it is approved in Products. The shop is told of the decision.
newProducts.validationOff: Off: a new product is visible to buyers as soon as it is saved. It can still be withdrawn later.
newProducts.emailsLabel: Addresses told of every new product
newProducts.emailsHint: One address per line, 20 at most. Leave empty to send no e-mail.
newProducts.invalidEmail: One of the addresses is not valid.

pickupPolicy.title: Time to collect a run
pickupPolicy.description: Once a run is accepted, the courier must collect the parcel within this delay, otherwise it is offered to another courier. The delay starts from the latest of: acceptance, the order being ready, and 30 minutes before the buyer's window. The courier is reminded before the run is taken back.
pickupPolicy.timeoutHint: Between 10 and 180 minutes. 25 minutes by default.
pickupPolicy.warningHint: Minutes before the delay ends. 10 minutes by default.
pickupPolicy.warningBeforeTimeout: The reminder must go out before the pickup delay ends.
pickupPolicy.error: The pickup delay could not be saved. Try again.

exchangeRates.title: Exchange rates
exchangeRates.description: What a buyer abroad sees in their currency. The foreign amount is frozen at payment: changing a rate does not affect past orders.
exchangeRates.missing: No rate: this currency is not offered until one is set.
exchangeRates.eurHint: Fixed CFA franc parity (655.957): this rate is never updated automatically.
exchangeRates.stale: This rate has not been updated for more than 72 h
exchangeRates.marginHint: Added to the rate to cover conversion costs. From 0 to 10 %, in steps of 0.1.
exchangeRates.refreshHint: “Refresh” downloads the US and Canadian dollar rates and replaces manually entered ones.
exchangeRates.notRefreshed: The rate service did not answer: the previous rates are kept. Try again later or enter them manually.
